g4h.rule: C-S8-68 / spec rev. 64 323.7 (times relative to the run start; t_f = first controller sample with the injected head fault): G4-1 the first FAULT_REGROUND-or-FAULT entry is at t_f and FAULT_HEAD_PRESSURE:<fault leg> is recorded there; G4-2 (rev. 64 323.9 ①) every leg airborne (1 ms pads) at >= 2 of the controller sample times t_f - 0.2, t_f - 0.1, t_f is a re-ground target (fault_reground_start legs); records: false targets, airborne ms in t_f +- 0.2 s, airborne at t_f, late_airborne (non-target > 20 ms in (t_f, t_f + 0.5] s); G4-3 FAULT (phase 'fault') <= t_f + 15 s and issued_u = 0 from FAULT + d T_s on (d = 1, C-S8-70 ① / rev. 65 333; the FAULT-sample issued_u is recorded); G4-4 (main, C-S8-71 / U-S8-72 (a), rev. 66 337) from FAULT + 1 s to the run end every leg's trailing 0.5 s moving mean of the judged true force (S8-A2; window end >= FAULT + 1 s) >= F_min and no pad lift-off (airborne samples 0, U-S8-74 (a) / rev. 68 354), undecidable when that window < 3 s (323.9 ②); records: instantaneous minimum > 0 and vs F_min (rev. 64 strict rule), time below F_min, airborne ms, mean and peak-to-peak over the last 2 s (C-S8-70 ②); G4-5 (323.9 ③) window [entry, FAULT + 1 s): healthy legs (neither the fault leg nor a target) never below F_min for more than 0.5 s in a row (shorter dips recorded), faulty-leg F_cyl max <= its extend force limit (YAML legs.<leg>.cylinder.max_force_extend_N; rises vs the entry sample and the pre-event median recorded), every leg's true head <= 345 bar; G4-6 (323.9 ④) trailing 0.5 s mean true roll / pitch minus the [t_f - 0.5, t_f] mean <= 0.5 deg over [t_f, FAULT + 1 s] (instant change recorded); G4-E (record, C-S8-71 ③) end attitude change after FAULT (last 0.5 s mean true roll / pitch minus the [FAULT - 0.5 s, FAULT] mean); the general rows run / 2 attitude / RE1b re-READY / 6 re-READY of a head-fault run (expect reground / negative / record) are not applicable (expected FAULT).
